export enum RequestState {
  Forecast = "Forecast",
  Released = "Released",
  Running = "Running",
  Completed = "Completed",
  Cancelled = "Cancelled",
}

export enum RunStatus {
  IDLE = "IDLE",
  RUNNING = "RUNNING",
  PAUSED = "PAUSED",
  COMPLETED = "COMPLETED",
}

export enum StockUpdateMode {
  PerCycle = "per_cycle",
  PerOrder = "per_order",
}

export enum EventType {
  RUN_STARTED = "RUN_STARTED",
  RUN_PAUSED = "RUN_PAUSED",
  RUN_RESET = "RUN_RESET",
  WORK_REQUEST_CREATED = "WORK_REQUEST_CREATED",
  WORK_REQUEST_UPDATED = "WORK_REQUEST_UPDATED",
  WORK_REQUEST_CANCELLED = "WORK_REQUEST_CANCELLED",
  WORK_REQUEST_STARTED = "WORK_REQUEST_STARTED",
  CYCLE_COMPLETED = "CYCLE_COMPLETED",
  WORK_REQUEST_COMPLETED = "WORK_REQUEST_COMPLETED",
  WORK_REQUEST_PARTIAL = "WORK_REQUEST_PARTIAL",
  STOCK_CREDITED = "STOCK_CREDITED",
  STOCK_CONSUMED = "STOCK_CONSUMED",
  UNDERSTOCK = "UNDERSTOCK",
  OVERSTOCK = "OVERSTOCK",
  SIMULATION_PAUSED_BOM_UNRESOLVED = "SIMULATION_PAUSED_BOM_UNRESOLVED",
}

export interface Machine {
  equipmentId: string
  name: string
  cycleTimeSeconds: number
  cycleTimeJitterPct: number
  leadTimeBeforeBottleneck: number
}

export interface Reference {
  material: string
  description: string
  unit: string
  stockMin: number
  stockMax: number
  initialStock: number
  piecesPerCycle: number
}

export interface MachineCapability {
  scheduledEquipmentId: string
  material: string
  cycleTimeOverride?: number
}

export interface SimulationRun {
  runId: string
  status: RunStatus
  startedAt?: string
  consumptionSignalId?: string
  signalLoop: boolean
  stockUpdateMode: StockUpdateMode
}

export interface SimStock {
  runId: string
  material: string
  currentStock: number
  lastUpdatedAt: string
}

export interface SimWorkRequest {
  id: string
  schedulerOrderId: string
  runId: string
  workMasterId: string
  workMasterVersion: string
  scheduledEquipmentId: string
  // Populated from the WorkMaster BOM cache once resolved (Phase 5).
  // Until then these fields may be absent and the engine will not start the order.
  material?: string
  durationSeconds?: number
  orderedQuantity: number
  remainingQuantity: number
  requestState: RequestState
  priority: number
  startTime: string
  endTime: string
  createdAt: string
  targetReleaseAt: string
  releasedAt?: string
  startedAt?: string
  completedAt?: string
  estimatedCompletionAt?: string
  nextCycleAt?: string
}

export interface SimConfig {
  leadTimeSeconds: number
}

export interface SimEvent {
  eventId: string
  runId: string
  simulationTime: string
  realTime: string
  type: EventType
  scheduledEquipmentId?: string
  material?: string
  orderId?: string
  quantity?: number
  stockAfter?: number
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}

export interface ConsumptionSignal {
  signalId: string
  description: string
  unit: string
  eventCount: number
}

export interface ConsumptionSignalEvent {
  signalId: string
  offsetSeconds: number
  material: string
  quantity: number
}

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - dev*
      - master
      - main

extends:
  template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
  parameters:
    prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
    prepare_sonarExclusions: "**/node_modules/**"
    prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
      sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
      sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
      sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src/

    step_postPrepare:
      - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
        parameters:
          nodejs_version: 22.x
          run_unit_tests: false
          run_documentation_analyzer: false
          run_scss_linter: false

      - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
        parameters:
          reports:
            - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
            - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
            - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
            - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
            - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
            - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:22.22 AS build

COPY --from=acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/cgr/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates/*.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
RUN update-ca-certificates

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json tsconfig*.json .npmrc ./
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc,required=false npm ci
COPY src/ src/
RUN npm run build

FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:22.22
COPY --from=acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/cgr/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates/*.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
RUN update-ca-certificates
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/package.json ./package.json
ENV NODE_ENV=production
RUN groupadd -r appgroup && useradd -r -g appgroup appuser
USER appuser
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"]

# Chronos — Routing & Production Version Object Model

## Overview

This document covers the object types and relationships involved in the **routing** domain: how a finished material is made (BOM, production version, routing steps) and how a resource is configured to run it (configuration, speed/TRS overrides, Gantt scheduling).

All primary keys and foreign-key columns are taken directly from `schemadb.sql`.

---

## Object Map

```
MATERIAL ──BOMNO──► BOM ──► BOM_ITEM (components)
│
└─► PROD_VERSION ──BOMNO──► BOM
                │
                └──ROUTINGNO──► ROUTING ──► ROUTING_OPERATION (steps, resources)

RESOURCE ──► CONFIGURATION ──► ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL ──► MATERIAL
│
└──► TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC (speed/TRS per material+config)
└──► GANTT_LOAD (scheduled events reference active config)
```

---

## Object Types

### MATERIAL

Master data record for a finished or semi-finished product.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MATNR` | varchar(50) | PK (composite) | Material number |
| `PLANT` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | Plant code |
| `DIVISION` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | Division code |
| `DESCRIPTION` | varchar(2048) | | Human-readable name |
| `TYPE` | varchar(10) | | Material type |
| `BOMNO` | int | FK → BOM | Direct BOM reference (shortcut; canonical path is via PROD_VERSION) |
| `NET_WEIGHT` | float | | Net weight |
| `UNIT_WEIGHT` | varchar(10) | | Weight unit |
| `AVAILABILITY` | int | | Availability horizon |
| `PRODUCTION_UNIT` | varchar(10) | | Base unit of measure for production |
| `PROCUREMENT_TYPE` | varchar(10) | | `E` (in-house) / `F` (external) / etc. |
| `PROCESS_TYPE` | varchar(10) | | Process classification |
| `STATUS` | varchar(1) | | Lifecycle status |
| `PLANIF_TYPE` | varchar(10) | | Planning type |
| `SAFETY_TIME` | int | | Safety lead time |
| `QUALITY_TIME` | int | | Quality inspection time |
| `QUALITY_TIME_UNIT` | varchar(10) | | |
| `MACE­RATION_TIME` | int | | Maceration/resting time |
| `ASSY_SCRAP` | float | | Assembly scrap rate |
| `COMP_SCRAP` | float | | Component scrap rate |
| `LAUNCH_DATE` | date | | Product launch date |
| `COST` | float | | Standard cost |

**Links:**
- `MATERIAL → BOM` (N:1) via `BOMNO` — direct BOM shortcut
- `MATERIAL → PROD_VERSION` (1:N) — reverse of `PROD_VERSION.(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)`

---

### BOM

Bill of Materials header. Defines the base quantity and validity window for one set of components.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BOM_NO` | int (identity) | PK | Auto-generated BOM number |
| `BASIC_QUANTITY` | float | | Base quantity for which component quantities apply |
| `UNIT` | varchar(10) | | Unit of measure for the base quantity |
| `DESCRIPTION` | varchar(255) | | Free-text description |
| `DETAILS` | varchar(100) | | Additional notes |
| `EXTERNAL_ID` | varchar(50) | | ERP reference key |
| `VALIDITY_START_DATE` | datetime | | Effective start |
| `VALIDITY_END_DATE` | datetime | | Effective end |

**Links:**
- `BOM → BOM_ITEM` (1:N) — reverse of `BOM_ITEM.BOM_NO`
- Referenced by `MATERIAL.BOMNO` and `PROD_VERSION.BOMNO`

---

### BOM_ITEM

One component line within a BOM.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ITEM_NO` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | Line item number within the BOM |
| `BOM_NO` | int | PK (composite), FK → BOM | Parent BOM |
| `MATNR` | varchar(18) | FK → MATERIAL | Component material number |
| `PLANT` | varchar(4) | FK → MATERIAL | Component plant |
| `DIVISION` | varchar(10) | FK → MATERIAL | Component division |
| `QUANTITY` | float | | Required quantity per base quantity |
| `UNIT` | varchar(10) | | Unit of measure |
| `SCRAP` | float | | Component-level scrap allowance |
| `STANDARD_ITEM` | varchar(10) | | Standard item flag |

**Links:**
- `BOM_ITEM → BOM` (N:1) via `BOM_NO`
- `BOM_ITEM → MATERIAL` (N:1) via `(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)`
- Referenced by `GANTT_LOAD_BOM_ITEM_ASSOC` (tracks which BOM items a Gantt event consumes)

---

### PROD_VERSION

Production version — the join between a material, its BOM, and its routing. Multiple versions can coexist with different validity ranges.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PLANT` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | Plant code |
| `MATNR` | varchar(50) | PK (composite) | Material number |
| `VERSNO` | varchar(20) | PK (composite) | Version identifier |
| `DIVISION` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | Division code |
| `VERS_TEXT` | varchar(50) | | Description |
| `BOMNO` | int | FK → BOM | Assigned BOM |
| `ROUTINGNO` | int | FK → ROUTING | Assigned routing |
| `STANDARD` | int | | Flag: 1 = standard/default version |
| `START_VALIDITY_DATE` | date | | Effective start |
| `END_VALIDITY_DATE` | date | | Effective end |

**Links:**
- `PROD_VERSION → BOM` (N:1) via `BOMNO`
- `PROD_VERSION → ROUTING` (N:1) via `ROUTINGNO`
- `PROD_VERSION → MATERIAL` (N:1) via `(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)`

---

### ROUTING

Routing header. Represents one sequence of manufacturing operations for a material on a resource.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROUTING_NO` | int (identity) | PK | Auto-generated routing number |
| `RESOURCE` | varchar(50) | FK → RESOURCE | Primary resource (entry point) |
| `STANDARD` | bit | | Flag: 1 = standard/default routing |
| `DESCRIPTION` | varchar(100) | | Free-text description |
| `EXTERNAL_ID` | varchar(50) | | ERP reference key |

**Links:**
- `ROUTING → RESOURCE` (N:1) via `RESOURCE`
- `ROUTING → ROUTING_OPERATION` (1:N) — reverse of `ROUTING_OPERATION.ROUTING_NO`
- Referenced by `PROD_VERSION.ROUTINGNO`

---

### ROUTING_OPERATION

One step within a routing — the operation performed on a specific resource.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OP_NO` | varchar(4) | PK (composite) | Operation sequence number |
| `ROUTING_NO` | int | PK (composite), FK → ROUTING | Parent routing |
| `RESOURCE` | varchar(50) | FK → RESOURCE | Resource that performs this operation |
| `RESOURCE_TYPE` | varchar(20) | | Resource type classification |
| `SPEED` | float | | Production speed for this operation |
| `UNIT` | varchar(10) | | Speed unit |
| `SETTING_TIME` | float | | Setup time before the operation |
| `SETTING_UNIT` | varchar(2) | | Setup time unit |
| `INTEROP_DELAY` | float | | Inter-operation delay after this step |
| `HAS_CYCLES` | bit | | Whether cycle-based scheduling applies |
| `CYCLE_CAPA` | float | | Capacity per cycle |
| `PREPARATION_TIME` | float | | Preparation duration |
| `STAFF` | float | | Staff headcount required |

**Links:**
- `ROUTING_OPERATION → ROUTING` (N:1) via `ROUTING_NO`
- `ROUTING_OPERATION → RESOURCE` (N:1) via `RESOURCE`

---

### RESOURCE

A production asset (line, machine, work centre) that can be scheduled.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | varchar(50) | PK (composite) | Resource identifier |
| `PLANT` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | Plant code |
| `TYPE` | varchar(50) | | Resource type |
| `TYPE_ERP` | varchar(10) | | ERP type code |
| `DESCRIPTION` | varchar(100) | | Human-readable name |
| `SPEED` | float | | Default production speed |
| `SPEED_TIME` | float | | Time window for speed measure |
| `SPEED_TIME_UNIT` | varchar(10) | | Unit for speed time window |
| `TRS` | float | | Default TRS (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) |
| `EQUIVALENT` | float | | Equivalent capacity factor |
| `UNIT` | varchar(10) | | Capacity unit |
| `SETUP_DURATION` | float | | Default setup duration |
| `SETUP_DURATION_UNIT` | varchar(10) | | |
| `CLEANING` | float | | Cleaning duration |
| `CLEANING_UNIT` | varchar(10) | | |
| `WASTE` | float | | Default waste rate |
| `MIN_CAPA` | float | | Minimum operating capacity |
| `FREEZE_DURATION` | float | | Minimum frozen scheduling horizon |
| `WAITING_TIME` | int | | Inter-order waiting time |
| `STAFF` | float | | Default staff headcount |
| `MULTI_RESOURCE` | bit | | Whether this is a multi-resource group |
| `MULTI_PRODUCTION` | bit | | Whether simultaneous productions are allowed |
| `NB_SIMULTANEOUS_USES` | int | | Maximum parallel uses |
| `MIN_TECHNICAL_DURATION` | int | | Minimum technical run duration |
| `IS_ADDITIONAL_LOAD_ACTIVATED` | int | | Additional load tracking flag |

**Links:**
- `RESOURCE → CONFIGURATION` (1:N) — reverse of `CONFIGURATION.RESOURCE`
- `RESOURCE → TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_ASSOC` (1:N) — per-material speed/TRS overrides
- `RESOURCE → TRS_SPEED_FAMILY_ASSOC` (1:N) — per-family speed/TRS overrides
- `RESOURCE → ROUTING` (1:N) — routings that list this resource as primary
- `RESOURCE → ROUTING_OPERATION` (1:N) — operations assigned to this resource

---

### CONFIGURATION

A named configuration of a resource (e.g. a specific tool set, mould, or format). A resource may have many configurations; only the active one applies at scheduling time.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | int (identity) | PK | Auto-generated configuration ID |
| `NAME` | varchar(50) | UNIQUE (NAME, PLANT) | Configuration name |
| `PLANT` | varchar(10) | UNIQUE (NAME, PLANT) | Plant code |
| `RESOURCE` | varchar(50) | FK → RESOURCE | Owning resource |
| `COLOR` | varchar(50) | | Display color in Gantt |

**Links:**
- `CONFIGURATION → RESOURCE` (N:1) via `RESOURCE`
- `CONFIGURATION → ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL` (1:N) — materials that can run under this configuration
- `CONFIGURATION → TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC` (1:N) — speed/TRS overrides per material for this configuration
- Referenced by `GANTT_LOAD.CONFIGURATION_ID`

---

### ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL

Junction table: which materials are compatible with (or can be produced under) a given configuration.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CONFIGURATION_ID` | int | PK (composite), FK → CONFIGURATION | Parent configuration |
| `MATNR` | varchar(50) | PK (composite), FK → MATERIAL | Compatible material |
| `PLANT` | varchar(10) | PK (composite), FK → MATERIAL | Plant |
| `DIVISION` | varchar(10) | FK → MATERIAL | Division |
| `VALUE` | int | | Compatibility or priority value |
| `COST` | int | | Change-over cost to this material under this configuration |

**Links:**
- `ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL → CONFIGURATION` (N:1) via `CONFIGURATION_ID`
- `ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL → MATERIAL` (N:1) via `(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)`

---

### TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC

Speed and TRS override for a specific **material + configuration** combination. Takes precedence over the resource-level defaults when the configuration is active.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CONFIG` | int | PK (composite), FK → CONFIGURATION | Configuration |
| `LINKED_MATERIAL` | varchar(50) | PK (composite), FK → MATERIAL | Target material |
| `PLANT` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | Plant |
| `DIVISION` | varchar(10) | FK → MATERIAL | Division |
| `SPEED` | float | | Override speed (units / time window) |
| `TRS` | float | | Override TRS rate |

**Links:**
- `TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC → CONFIGURATION` (N:1) via `CONFIG`
- `TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC → MATERIAL` (N:1) via `(LINKED_MATERIAL, PLANT, DIVISION)`

> **Related tables (not in the primary object map):**
> - `TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_ASSOC` — speed/TRS override per resource + material, without configuration context.
> - `TRS_SPEED_FAMILY_ASSOC` — speed/TRS override per resource + material family.

---

### GANTT_LOAD

A scheduled production event (order slot) on a resource. References the active configuration at scheduling time, and optionally the routing used.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | bigint (identity) | PK | Auto-generated event ID |
| `RESOURCE` | varchar(50) | FK → RESOURCE | Resource the event is scheduled on |
| `PLANT` | varchar(10) | | Plant |
| `ENTITY` | varchar(50) | | Material or product entity |
| `WORKSHOP` | varchar(50) | | Workshop grouping |
| `STARTDATE` | datetime | | Scheduled start |
| `ENDDATE` | datetime | | Scheduled end |
| `TYPE` | varchar(50) | | Event type (production, cleaning, setup, …) |
| `ORDERNO` | varchar(50) | | Manufacturing order number |
| `VALUE` | float | | Planned quantity |
| `UNIT` | varchar(50) | | Quantity unit |
| `CONFIGURATION_ID` | int | FK → CONFIGURATION | Active configuration at scheduling time |
| `ROUTING` | varchar(20) | | Routing identifier applied to this event |
| `PRODVERSION` | varchar(50) | | Production version applied |
| `SPEED` | float | | Effective speed at scheduling time (snapshot) |
| `SPEED_CHANGE` | int | | Whether a speed change was applied |
| `SCENARIO_NAME` | varchar(50) | | Scenario this event belongs to |
| `RECIPE` | varchar(50) | | Recipe reference |
| `DDM` | datetime | | Desired delivery/manufacture date |
| `WASTE` | float | | Waste applied to this event |
| `STAFF` | float | | Staff assigned |
| `FIXED` | int | | Whether the event is locked/frozen |
| `VISIBLE` | bit | | Display flag |
| `ARCHIVED` | bit | | Archive flag |
| `BATCH_NUMBER` | varchar(50) | | Batch reference |
| `FILLING_LINK` | varchar(50) | | Link to a filling/upstream event |
| `CONNECTION` | varchar(50) | | Downstream connection reference |
| `TOOL_LINK` | varchar(100) | | Tool attachment reference |
| `GROUP_KEY` | varchar(50) | | Grouping key for multi-operation orders |
| `ENTITY_DATE` | datetime | | Entity reference date |

**Links:**
- `GANTT_LOAD → RESOURCE` (N:1) via `RESOURCE`
- `GANTT_LOAD → CONFIGURATION` (N:1) via `CONFIGURATION_ID`
- `GANTT_LOAD → GANTT_LOAD_BOM_ITEM_ASSOC` (1:N) — BOM items consumed by this event

---

### GANTT_LOAD_BOM_ITEM_ASSOC

Tracks which BOM items (components) are consumed by a given Gantt event.

| Column | Type | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GANTT_LOAD_ID` | bigint | PK (composite), FK → GANTT_LOAD | Parent Gantt event |
| `ITEM_NO` | varchar(10) | PK (composite) | BOM item line number |
| `BOM_ID` | varchar(20) | PK (composite) | BOM identifier |

**Links:**
- `GANTT_LOAD_BOM_ITEM_ASSOC → GANTT_LOAD` (N:1) via `GANTT_LOAD_ID`
- `GANTT_LOAD_BOM_ITEM_ASSOC → BOM_ITEM` (N:1) via `(ITEM_NO, BOM_ID)`

---

## Relation Summary

| From | To | Cardinality | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| MATERIAL | BOM | N:1 | `BOMNO` |
| MATERIAL | PROD_VERSION | 1:N | reverse of `PROD_VERSION.(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)` |
| BOM | BOM_ITEM | 1:N | reverse of `BOM_ITEM.BOM_NO` |
| BOM_ITEM | MATERIAL | N:1 | `(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)` |
| PROD_VERSION | MATERIAL | N:1 | `(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)` |
| PROD_VERSION | BOM | N:1 | `BOMNO` |
| PROD_VERSION | ROUTING | N:1 | `ROUTINGNO` |
| ROUTING | RESOURCE | N:1 | `RESOURCE` |
| ROUTING | ROUTING_OPERATION | 1:N | reverse of `ROUTING_OPERATION.ROUTING_NO` |
| ROUTING_OPERATION | ROUTING | N:1 | `ROUTING_NO` |
| ROUTING_OPERATION | RESOURCE | N:1 | `RESOURCE` |
| RESOURCE | CONFIGURATION | 1:N | reverse of `CONFIGURATION.RESOURCE` |
| RESOURCE | TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_ASSOC | 1:N | reverse of `TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_ASSOC.RESOURCE` |
| RESOURCE | TRS_SPEED_FAMILY_ASSOC | 1:N | reverse of `TRS_SPEED_FAMILY_ASSOC.RESOURCE` |
| CONFIGURATION | RESOURCE | N:1 | `RESOURCE` |
| CONFIGURATION | ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL | 1:N | reverse of `ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL.CONFIGURATION_ID` |
| CONFIGURATION | TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC | 1:N | reverse of `TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC.CONFIG` |
| ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL | CONFIGURATION | N:1 | `CONFIGURATION_ID` |
| ASSOC_CONFIGURATION_MATERIAL | MATERIAL | N:1 | `(MATNR, PLANT, DIVISION)` |
| TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC | CONFIGURATION | N:1 | `CONFIG` |
| TRS_SPEED_MATERIAL_CONFIG_ASSOC | MATERIAL | N:1 | `(LINKED_MATERIAL, PLANT, DIVISION)` |
| GANTT_LOAD | RESOURCE | N:1 | `RESOURCE` |
| GANTT_LOAD | CONFIGURATION | N:1 | `CONFIGURATION_ID` |
| GANTT_LOAD | GANTT_LOAD_BOM_ITEM_ASSOC | 1:N | reverse of `GANTT_LOAD_BOM_ITEM_ASSOC.GANTT_LOAD_ID` |

# Chronos — Palantir Foundry Ontology Definition

## Overview

Nine object types total: three master data (read-only, assumed to already exist) and six simulation state types (new, read/write).

All relations use single-property primary keys. Object types that would naturally use a composite key (`SimStock`, `ConsumptionSignalEvent`) are given a synthetic UUID primary key so they can participate in Foundry links.

---

## Master Data (existing — read only)

### Machine

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prod_work_center_code` | String | Yes | Unique work center identifier (`ScheduledEquipmentID`) |
| `name` | String | | Human-readable name |
| `cycleTimeSeconds` | Double | | Default cycle time in seconds per piece |
| `cycleTimeJitterPct` | Double | | ±% random variability per cycle |
| `leadTimeBeforeBottleneck` | Double | | Simulation seconds before `startTime` at which a Forecast order is released |

---

### Reference

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `material` | String | Yes | Part number |
| `description` | String | | Human-readable description |
| `unit` | String | | `pcs`, `kg`, etc. |
| `stockMin` | Double | | Replenishment trigger level |
| `stockMax` | Double | | Replenishment target level |
| `initialStock` | Double | | Starting stock level for a new simulation run |
| `piecesPerCycle` | Double | | Units produced per machine cycle |

---

### MachineCapability

> Junction object between Machine and Reference. Assumed to have a synthetic primary key if not already present.

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `capabilityId` | String | Yes | Synthetic UUID if not already present |
| `prod_work_center_code` | String | | FK to Machine |
| `material` | String | | FK to Reference |
| `cycleTimeOverride` | Double | | Optional; overrides Machine.cycleTimeSeconds for this reference |

**Links (existing):**
- `MachineCapability → Machine` (N:1) via `prod_work_center_code`
- `MachineCapability → Reference` (N:1) via `material`

---

## Simulation State (new object types)

### SimulationRun

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runId` | String | Yes | System-generated UUID |
| `status` | String | | Enum: `IDLE`, `RUNNING`, `PAUSED`, `COMPLETED` |
| `startedAt` | Timestamp | | Wall-clock time the run was started |
| `timeAcceleration` | Double | | Speed multiplier (e.g. `60` = 1 s real → 1 min sim) |
| `consumptionSignalId` | String | | FK to ConsumptionSignal |
| `signalLoop` | Boolean | | Whether to replay the signal on loop |
| `stockUpdateMode` | String | | Enum: `per_cycle`, `per_order` |

**Links:**
- `SimulationRun → ConsumptionSignal` (N:1) via `consumptionSignalId`
- `SimulationRun → SimWorkRequest` (1:N) — reverse of `SimWorkRequest.runId`
- `SimulationRun → SimStock` (1:N) — reverse of `SimStock.runId`
- `SimulationRun → SimEvent` (1:N) — reverse of `SimEvent.runId`

---

### SimStock

> Tracks the current stock level for one reference within one simulation run. Natural key would be (`runId`, `material`) — a synthetic primary key is required instead.

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stockId` | String | Yes | Synthetic UUID (`runId + "::" + material` at creation time) |
| `runId` | String | | FK to SimulationRun |
| `material` | String | | FK to Reference |
| `currentStock` | Double | | Current stock level |
| `lastUpdatedAt` | Timestamp | | Simulation clock time of last change |

**Links:**
- `SimStock → SimulationRun` (N:1) via `runId`
- `SimStock → Reference` (N:1) via `material`

---

### SimWorkRequest

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | Yes | Simulator-generated UUID (ISA-95 `ID`) |
| `schedulerOrderId` | String | | Scheduler-supplied identifier (`SchedulerOrderID`) |
| `runId` | String | | FK to SimulationRun |
| `scheduledEquipmentId` | String | | FK to Machine (`ScheduledEquipmentID`) |
| `material` | String | | FK to Reference |
| `orderedQuantity` | Double | | Total quantity to produce (`OrderedQuantity`) |
| `remainingQuantity` | Double | | Quantity still to produce — decremented each cycle (`RemainingQuantity`) |
| `requestState` | String | | ISA-95 enum: `Forecast`, `Released`, `Running`, `Completed`, `Cancelled` |
| `priority` | Double | | Execution order within the machine queue (ascending) |
| `startTime` | Timestamp | | Requested start time from scheduler |
| `endTime` | Timestamp | | Requested end time from scheduler (optional) |
| `createdAt` | Timestamp | | Wall-clock creation time |
| `targetReleaseAt` | Timestamp | | Simulation time the release job will fire for this request |
| `releasedAt` | Timestamp | | Simulation time the request was actually released (optional) |
| `startedAt` | Timestamp | | Simulation time production began / first cycle ran (optional) |
| `completedAt` | Timestamp | | Simulation time the request reached a terminal state (optional) |
| `estimatedCompletionAt` | Timestamp | | Recomputed after each cycle; not persisted to Foundry (in-memory only) |

**Links:**
- `SimWorkRequest → SimulationRun` (N:1) via `runId`
- `SimWorkRequest → Machine` (N:1) via `scheduledEquipmentId`
- `SimWorkRequest → Reference` (N:1) via `material`
- `SimWorkRequest → SimEvent` (1:N) — reverse of `SimEvent.orderId`

---

### SimEvent

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | String | Yes | System-generated UUID |
| `runId` | String | | FK to SimulationRun |
| `simulationTime` | Timestamp | | Simulation clock time of the event |
| `realTime` | Timestamp | | Wall-clock time of the event |
| `type` | String | | Enum — see Event Types below |
| `prod_work_center_code` | String | | FK to Machine (optional) |
| `material` | String | | FK to Reference (optional) |
| `orderId` | String | | FK to SimWorkRequest (optional) |
| `quantity` | Double | | Quantity involved in the event (optional) |
| `stockAfter` | Double | | Stock level after the event — stock events only (optional) |
| `metadata` | String | | JSON string for additional context (e.g. shortfall on UNDERSTOCK) |

**Links:**
- `SimEvent → SimulationRun` (N:1) via `runId`
- `SimEvent → SimWorkRequest` (N:1) via `orderId`
- `SimEvent → Machine` (N:1) via `scheduledEquipmentId`
- `SimEvent → Reference` (N:1) via `material`

**Event type values:** `RUN_STARTED`, `RUN_PAUSED`, `RUN_RESET`, `WORK_REQUEST_CREATED`, `WORK_REQUEST_UPDATED`, `WORK_REQUEST_CANCELLED`, `WORK_REQUEST_STARTED`, `CYCLE_COMPLETED`, `WORK_REQUEST_COMPLETED`, `WORK_REQUEST_PARTIAL`, `STOCK_CREDITED`, `STOCK_CONSUMED`, `UNDERSTOCK`, `OVERSTOCK`

---

### ConsumptionSignal

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signalId` | String | Yes | User-supplied identifier |
| `description` | String | | Human-readable description |
| `unit` | String | | `pcs`, `kg`, etc. |
| `eventCount` | Integer | | Total number of events in this signal |

**Links:**
- `ConsumptionSignal → ConsumptionSignalEvent` (1:N) — reverse of `ConsumptionSignalEvent.signalId`
- `ConsumptionSignal → SimulationRun` (1:N) — reverse of `SimulationRun.consumptionSignalId`

---

### ConsumptionSignalEvent

> Natural key would be (`signalId`, `offsetSeconds`, `material`) — a synthetic primary key is required instead.

| Property | Type | Primary Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signalEventId` | String | Yes | Synthetic UUID assigned at ingestion time |
| `signalId` | String | | FK to ConsumptionSignal |
| `offsetSeconds` | Double | | Time offset from signal start (simulation seconds, before acceleration) |
| `material` | String | | FK to Reference |
| `quantity` | Double | | Pieces withdrawn at this offset |

**Links:**
- `ConsumptionSignalEvent → ConsumptionSignal` (N:1) via `signalId`
- `ConsumptionSignalEvent → Reference` (N:1) via `material`

---

## Relation Summary

| From | To | Cardinality | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| MachineCapability | Machine | N:1 | `prod_work_center_code` |
| MachineCapability | Reference | N:1 | `material` |
| SimulationRun | ConsumptionSignal | N:1 | `consumptionSignalId` |
| SimWorkRequest | SimulationRun | N:1 | `runId` |
| SimWorkRequest | Machine | N:1 | `scheduledEquipmentId` |
| SimWorkRequest | Reference | N:1 | `material` |
| SimStock | SimulationRun | N:1 | `runId` |
| SimStock | Reference | N:1 | `material` |
| SimEvent | SimulationRun | N:1 | `runId` |
| SimEvent | SimWorkRequest | N:1 | `orderId` |
| SimEvent | Machine | N:1 | `scheduledEquipmentId` |
| SimEvent | Reference | N:1 | `material` |
| ConsumptionSignalEvent | ConsumptionSignal | N:1 | `signalId` |
| ConsumptionSignalEvent | Reference | N:1 | `material` |
